My conclusion: Patel has skids under him, just as Noem and Bondi did. Start the clock.
His baggage exceeds his utility. Blanche can protect Trump without Patel and likely wants rid of him. A new AG will want rid of him. Wiles must be sick of him.
Also, multiple agent lawsuits loom and will oblige Patel to testify. He will be a train wreck under competent examination, and leave a big mess.
My guess is that Patel is next to go. He is DOJ’s Lewandowski: jets and partying not popular; lying to Congress not resolved; astounding incompetence.
Many of the worst-hit states are represented by fossil-fuel-funded Republicans who ignore climate perils, so local advocacy could matter.

It’s easy to be out-muscled by the thug muscle of the fossil fuel industry, but it’s really a shame barely even to try. 
yaleclimateconnections.org/2…
No wonder people are fed up and Trump polling is collapsing into low 30s range. They can’t govern. Incompetence reigns. Gangster gong show.
Republicans can’t get out of their own way, insist on an unnecessary shutdown, won’t challenge an unnecessary war, ignore epic corruption.

This week, massive failure to execute on House side on the deal they had just orchestrated with Senate Republicans — it is truly the gang who couldn’t shoot straight, this time into own feet. Sadly, DHS employees must bear the cost.

Plus, OMB says that ICE/CBP can be funded by the billions they put aside in the Beautiful for Billionaires bill. They had the money all along.  
cdn.sanity.io/files/ifn0l6bs…
House Republicans could have accepted the unanimous Senate end to the shutdown, but instead they prolonged it unnecessarily as they quarreled. And now fumbled the ball.
Senate Republicans could have accepted our offer of “yes” on Day One. Instead they held TSA, FEMA, Coast Guard etc hostage, before coming to their senses.
At the end, the whole shutdown was completely unnecessary and 100% caused by Republican dysfunction. 🧵

Key text: the U.S. has “failed to sanction a single new tanker under the current administration.” 

More Trump/Russia.  
kyivindependent.com/exclusiv…
